headline: LAA @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAA 3.76 at TOR 4.10, with a projected total of 7.86. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAA: LAA moved -0.42 runs while TOR moved -0.70, changing the projected margin by +0.27 runs. The projected total fell -1.12, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Spencer Miles has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Kazuma Okamoto, Nolan Schanuel, Mike Trout, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Davis Schneider, Josh Lowe because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
